project.description: The Melon country, the dry ground the melons' village stands on, as data: the Melon plain the village lies on, MontMelon to the north, ribbed as a melon is, the Melon Downs to the west, the Melon River running down from MontMelon past the village into Melon Bay, and the bay between Melon Point and Melon Head, deepening out to the open sea. No water: the river's bed and the bay's lie dry, as deep as they are.
